title: Interview PMs, leaders and partner teams
summary: Before changing anything, find out how product work really happens. Talk to PMs, their managers and the teams they work with.

beginner: Write a short interview guide with open questions.
Interview a mix of PMs, leaders, designers and engineers.
Ask about recent real examples, not general opinions.
Take notes and look for common themes.
Share the themes without naming people.
intermediate: Include partner teams such as sales, support and finance.
Probe for the causes behind common complaints.
Test early themes with a second round of conversations.
experienced: Interview senior leaders about their expectations of product.
Spot differences between what leaders say and what teams experience.
Use the themes to build support for change.

canDelegateTo.task: Help design the guide and analyse themes

toolExamples.google-docs: Keep the interview guide and notes together.

definitionOfDone: At least eight people interviewed across roles
